key_insight: ClinRAG-GRAPH combines MRI, clinical, and pathology data with graph learning and retrieval-based evidence to improve pre-treatment prediction of breast pCR.
clinical_relevance: If validated, this approach could help stratify patients before neoadjuvant chemotherapy and support more personalized breast cancer treatment planning.
method: Builds an intra-patient clinical-prior graph from DCE-MRI, structured clinical variables, and biopsy biomarkers
Uses a prior-guided relation-aware graph convolutional network to learn multimodal representations
Adds dual-branch domain-adversarial learning plus LLM-driven subgraph retrieval for robustness and interpretability
evidence_signal: In a multicenter breast cancer cohort, the model achieved AUC 0.815 on the internal test set and 0.774 and 0.712 on two external test sets.
watch_item: Performance is promising but implementation may be limited by multicenter imaging variability, the need for high-quality structured inputs, and the complexity of deploying retrieval-and-LLM components safely.
paper_title: ClinRAG-GRAPH: Clinical-prior Retrieval-Augmented Graph Model with Domain Adversarial Learning for Breast pCR Prediction
